description: Upload a file into Velixar memory with full source provenance. Supports PDF, Markdown, text, CSV, JSON, DOCX, and code files. Parsed, chunked, and tagged with source metadata.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file to upload (e.g. /Users/me/docs/report.pdf)

quarantine_zone.description: Optional quarantine zone ID for all uploaded memories

tags.description: Optional tags to apply to all resulting memories

name: velixar_upload
